directAnswer: You can test an email address by sending a test email or using an online email verification tool to check its validity.
summary: Testing an email address ensures that it is valid and capable of receiving messages. This can be done through direct methods or verification tools.

sections.heading: Sending a Test Email
sections.body: The simplest way to test an email address is to send a test email. If the email bounces back, the address may be invalid.

sections.heading: Using Online Verification Tools
sections.body: There are several online tools available that can verify the validity of an email address without sending an email. These tools check the format and domain of the email.

steps.title: Send a Test Email
steps.detail: Compose a new email in your email client and send it to the address you want to test. Check for bounce-back messages.

steps.title: Use an Email Verification Tool
steps.detail: Visit a reputable email verification website, enter the email address, and follow the instructions to check its validity.

faqs.question: What should I do if my test email bounces?
faqs.answer: If your test email bounces, it indicates that the email address is likely invalid or does not exist.

faqs.question: Are email verification tools reliable?
faqs.answer: Most email verification tools are reliable, but results can vary based on the tool's algorithms and the email provider.

faqs.question: Can I verify an email address without sending an email?
faqs.answer: Yes, using online verification tools allows you to check an email address without sending a message.

caveats: Some email servers may accept all addresses regardless of validity, leading to false positives in tests.
